Moshi is pretrained with an acoustic‑delay of 2 and then finetuned with an acoustic‑delay of 1 to achieve the reported 160 ms theoretical latency[C:moshi:81].
Helium was trained with a text‑only batch size of 4.2 million tokens and for 500 k training steps[C:moshi:59].
Mimi’s latent representation has dimension 512 [C:moshi:29], and its embeddings are projected down to 256 dimensions before the residual vector quantizer is applied [C:moshi:32].

Moshi uses a text vocabulary of size 32 000 tokens and an audio token set of size 2 048, with a processing frame rate of 12.5 Hz[C:moshi:24]. This is confirmed in the hyper‑parameter table where the same values are listed for the model’s input/output space[C:moshi:t0].
Moshi is trained with the AdamW optimizer and a weight‑decay of 0.1 in all of its training phases[C:moshi:58].
